ic_name: AMBA AXI4-Stream Protocol (ARM IHI 0051, Single Unidirectional Stream Channel)
notes: AXI4-Stream is an on-chip interface specification; it defines no OTP/fuse content. Any configuration (signal widths, optional-signal presence, packetization, routing) is set at design/elaboration time, not burned into fuses. This layer is genuinely N/A for the AXI4-Stream interface contract.
